description: End-to-end build task: write a module + a self-test, run it, iterate until it passes. Measures edit→run→verify loop and drift (dependency-free, no npm install).

turns.send: Build this end to end in THIS workspace only (do not touch any file outside it) and iterate until it works: 1) Create a file priceList.mjs exporting a PriceList class backed by a Map with setPrice(item, cents), getPrice(item) returning the number or undefined, removePrice(item) returning true/false, and total() returning the sum of all prices. 2) Create a file priceList.selftest.mjs that imports PriceList, exercises every method INCLUDING removePrice on a missing item and total() after a removal, and prints exactly 'ALL PASS' only if every assertion holds, otherwise prints which assertion failed. 3) Run it with run_command using 'node priceList.selftest.mjs'. 4) If it fails, fix and re-run until it prints ALL PASS. Report the final command output.
